description: Fires in sharp tactical positions where the game hinges on one column, mostly column 4 (sometimes 2): my only winning move, the only must-block, or the only move that does not lose is in column 4/2. Typical boards have column 3 tall or full and column 4 holding 1-2 stones. Mirror-image positions (column 2 vs 4 swapped) mostly do not fire. Only covers about half of firing; the rest is unexplained.
effect: Weak. Forcing it high on non-firing positions lowers column 3 by about 12-20 points (moved to columns 2/4/1); turning it off at firing positions changes moves by under 3 points.
notes: Tried: shape (h4 1-2, h3 tall) F1 0.11; opponent gain at col-4 landing 0.18; any unique non-losing move 0.14; col-4 critical 0.25; line potential at (2,4) 0.13; best = unique critical column in {4,2} F1 0.30 (P 0.23 R 0.45, AUROC 0.70), sim share 0.13. Minimal pairs: strongly col-4 specific (mirrors fail), board- not move-order-based, depends on my stacked col-4 stones in one top example. Description captures a correlate; unit may be a mixture or random direction.
